q: Why do I keep picking the same kind of person?
prose: {"answer":[{"text":"Start with Venus, the planet of what draws you and what you're drawn toward. Yours sits in Aries, in the ninth house — the part of the chart tied to what stretches your world past what you already know: belief, distance, a bigger frame. Venus there is in detriment, out of its comfort, so it doesn't relate slowly. It decides fast, on instinct, and it's pulled toward whoever feels like an opening rather than whoever is simply kind. Add that Venus sits in a stellium with the Sun and Lilith, also in Aries, also in the ninth house: three bodies insisting the same thing at once. You don't drift into attraction. You commit to it early, before you've had time to check whether the person or just the size of the feeling is what you want.","factors":["venus 16°00′ ♈︎ · house 9 · detriment","stellium: lilith, sun, venus (3 bodies in Aries)"]},{"text":"Venus also makes an easy angle to your ascendant — a trine, the kind of aspect that costs nothing, so this pull doesn't feel like a struggle. But Venus is also quincunx Jupiter, an awkward angle, a hundred and fifty degrees, the kind that needs constant readjustment. What you want and how much of it you want don't sit at the same size. You reach for someone who seems to promise expansion — more life, more scale — and then spend the relationship trying to make that promise fit an ordinary week.","factors":["♀ △ ASC · 2°44′","♀ ⚻ ♃ · 2°01′"]},{"text":"Underneath that is a second pattern, quieter, in Pisces. It sits conjunct Saturn, which adds delay and a kind of testing to how you communicate desire, and it opposes Chiron, in your first house, in Virgo — a wound about being seen clearly. You keep finding partners who make you repeat the same difficulty: wanting to merge completely while not quite being able to say, in plain words, what you need from the merging.","factors":["stellium: mars, mercury, saturn (3 bodies in Pisces)","mercury 3°05′ ♓︎ · house 7 · detriment","☿ ☌ ♄ · 3°04′","☿ ☍ ⚷ · 1°14′","chiron 4°19′ ♍︎ · house 1 · retrograde"]},{"text":"Here's what makes the pattern hard to notice while it's happening: your Moon, Mars and Jupiter form a grand trine in water. Someone consuming and someone who won't fully be pinned down, at the same time.
